Title: Product Manager (B2C)
Location: Gurgaon

Who We Are:
Fareportal is a travel technology company powering a next-generation travel concierge service. Utilizing its innovative technology and company owned and operated global contact centres, Fareportal has built strong industry partnerships providing customers access to over 500 airlines, a million lodgings, and hundreds of car rental companies around the globe. With a portfolio of consumer travel brands including CheapOair and OneTravel, Fareportal enables consumers to book-online, on mobile apps for iOS and Android, by phone, or live chat. Fareportal provides its airline partners with access to a broad customer base that books high-yielding international travel and add-on ancillaries.

HIGHLIGHTS:
• Fareportal is the number 1 privately held online travel company in flight volume.
• Fareportal partners with over 500 airlines, 1 million lodgings, and hundreds of car rental companies worldwide.
• 2019 annual sales exceeded $5 billion.
• Fareportal sees over 150 million unique visitors annually to our desktop and mobile sites.
• Fareportal, with its global workforce of over 2,600 employees, is strategically positioned with 9 offices in 6 countries and headquartered in New York City.

Role Overview
Fareportal is looking for a collaborative and inspirational Product Manager to join their India product team in Gurgaon. You will work with stakeholders across the globe to create product roadmap and execute the business strategy to meet business goals. S/he should have the penchant to solve complex product problems with simplest possible solutions.

Job Description / What you’ll do 
• Be curious! Build a product that offers a great experience for our users to book flights, hotels, and more. 
• Own the product roadmap. Maintain a backlog, groom it, prioritize it and translate it to prioritized sprint plans.
• Evaluate industry, competitor, market, and technology trends as inputs into the product roadmap.
• Work closely with a team of skilled engineers to deliver sprints on time and set the high-level mission, vision, and roadmap for the platform and the team.
• Ensure that your team is constantly doing the right things, and has a healthy balance of innovation, reducing technical debt and providing maintenance and support.
• Collaborate with stakeholders across the organization to achieve company’s short- and long-term goals.

Required Skills and Qualification
 
• 4-6 years of product management experience.
• 2-3 years of hands-on experience in product analytics.
• Experience of working in OTA, e-commerce or technology startup is preferred.
• Experience of working in an agile scrum environment.
• Overall strong, product and technology awareness/background. 
• Strong communicator - verbal and written.
• Self-motivated, proactive and willing to call out issues and challenge status quo.
• Strong with Data Analysis, Excel, A/B testing methodologies. 
• Engineering Degree from a reputed college (IITs/NITs, etc.) with MBA from reputed college.

Disclaimer
This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Fareportal reserves the right to change the job duties, responsibilities, expectations or requirements posted here at any time at the Company’s sole discretion, with or without notice.

12098c1b8aad342f.description: Asia's leading robotics solutions provider, automating enterprise supply chains since 2017. We build syncOS — the industry-first no-code platform that lets manufacturers and warehouse operators integrate, reprogram, and scale automation systems without halting production or calling in specialists. Our autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) run 24/7 for global brands like Ford, Coca-Cola, and Kimberly-Clark — transforming production lines in hours, not weeks. We started as roboticists ourselves. We know the pain of fragmented, proprietary systems that refuse to talk to each other. syncOS is our answer — and we believe it's what the industry has been waiting for. We are a young, passionate team chasing one big mission: #automateasia. If you love robots, hate inefficiency, and want to build solutions that run on real factory floors — read on. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:** - Owner of the algorithms that decide how the fleet moves - task allocation, routing, and traffic management across every AMR on site. - Turn multi-robot coordination problems into algorithms that hold up under real site load, and prove it with data, not intuition. - Task allocation, end to end - You design and maintain the algorithms that decide which AMR takes which job, balancing throughput, battery state, and site layout across the fleet. - Traffic and conflict resolution - You own the logic that keeps AMRs from colliding, deadlocking, or queuing badly at shared paths, intersections, and pick/drop points - across every MAG AMR variant and lifter generation in the fleet. - Routing and path optimization - You build and tune the routing algorithms that get robots from A to B efficiently, adapting to site-specific layouts and constraints. - Algorithm quality under real load - You validate changes against simulated and live fleet data before they ship, so a fix for one site doesn't regress another. - Instrumentation and tuning - You build the metrics and tooling to see how the fleet is actually performing (throughput, congestion, idle time) and use them to tune the algorithms, not guesswork. - Collaboration on the interface - You work with the platform and robotics teams to keep the algorithm layer working cleanly against the AMR-syncOS interface contract. **You will partner closely with:** - Fleet manager team lead: on what problem to solve next and how it fits the fleet manager roadmap - they set priorities, you own the algorithm design. - Platform engineers (Integrator, dashboard): on the APIs and data your algorithms depend on and expose. - Robotics Engineering: on the AMR-syncOS interface contract - what the fleet manager can assume about robot behavior, and what it must account for across AMR variants. - Quality: who independently test and certify releases - you build to the bar, they verify it. **WHAT DOES SUCCESS LOOK LIKE FOR THIS ROLE** **3 months:** - Shipped your first change to fleet manager algorithm logic into a live customer environment - Fluent in how task allocation, routing, and traffic management work today across the fleet - Able to reproduce and diagnose a reported fleet-behavior issue (e.g. congestion, bad allocation) end to end - Working directly with the fleet manager team lead with minimal ramp-up friction **6 months:** - Owning a defined algorithm area (e.g. traffic management or task allocation) with minimal oversight - Built or improved the simulation/backtesting tooling used to validate algorithm changes before ship - Trusted to review other engineers' changes to fleet manager algorithm code - Tuned an algorithm against live site data with a measurable throughput or congestion improvement **12 months:** - A recognized go-to engineer for fleet manager algorithms - Your algorithm changes ship across multiple sites with minimal live-site escalations - Contributed a reusable improvement (tooling, technique, or component) that other algorithm work builds on - Mentoring newer engineers joining the fleet manager team **Requirements** - 6 years of software engineering experience with real, hands-on work on algorithmic problems (scheduling, routing, graph search, optimization, or similar). - Strong CS fundamentals - data structures, algorithms, complexity analysis - and the ability to reason about correctness under concurrency. - Experience with simulation, backtesting, or data-driven validation of algorithm changes before they ship. - Exposure to multi-agent or multi-robot systems, path planning, or traffic/scheduling problems is a strong plus, not a requirement. - Proficiency in at least one systems language (e.g. Python, C++) used to implement and productionize algorithms. - Comfort operating in a fast-moving startup building for real industrial customers. **Benefits** - Competitive salary - Comprehensive health benefits package - Hustle of a young startup, always something to do and something to improve - Opportunities for professional development and growth into management roles - Collaborative and inclusive work environment

About the Company
HyperVerge is one of India's leading identity verification and digital onboarding platforms, helping enterprises onboard users seamlessly through AI-powered verification, compliance, and workflow automation solutions. Our products power customer onboarding journeys across banking, financial services, fintech, insurance, and other regulated industries.

About the Role
We are looking for a highly motivated and analytically driven Associate Product Manager to join our product team. In this role, you will work closely with product leaders, engineering teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to build and improve B2B enterprise products that solve meaningful customer problems at scale. This role is ideal for someone who has experience working in B2B SaaS and enterprise environments, enjoys solving complex customer problems, and can work closely with engineering teams to drive product development and execution. We are particularly interested in candidates with a strong technical foundation, including those who have transitioned from software engineering into product management, as well as candidates who have experience building technically complex products or taking products/features from 0→1.

Responsibilities

Product Discovery & Analysis
• Analyze product usage, customer feedback, and operational data to identify opportunities for improvement.
• Understand enterprise customer journeys, uncover pain points, and recommend solutions that drive better outcomes.
• Conduct customer and stakeholder discovery to understand business requirements and product opportunities.
• Monitor product performance and track key business and product metrics.

Product Development & Execution
• Own and support the end-to-end product development lifecycle, from problem definition to launch and iteration.
• Write clear and actionable PRDs, product requirements, user stories, and functional specifications.
• Work closely with engineering teams to translate customer and business problems into scalable product solutions.
• Partner with engineering, design, and QA teams to ensure successful execution of product initiatives.
• Define rollout plans, success metrics, edge cases, and post-launch evaluation frameworks.
• Contribute to 0→1 product and feature development.

Stakeholder & Customer Collaboration
• Work closely with enterprise customers and internal teams to gather requirements and understand business needs.
• Translate customer insights into product improvements and roadmap recommendations.
• Act as a bridge between product, engineering, business, operations, and external stakeholders.
• Build a strong understanding of customer workflows and business contexts to drive product decisions.

Product Performance & Optimization
• Track product health, user engagement, and operational performance through dashboards and reporting tools.
• Conduct root-cause analysis on product issues and work with engineering teams to drive resolution.
• Support experimentation, funnel analysis, and optimization initiatives to improve product outcomes.
• Use data and customer feedback to identify opportunities for product improvements.

Technical & Product Thinking
• Work closely with engineering teams on technically complex product problems.
• Develop an understanding of APIs, integrations, system workflows, and platform architecture.
• Evaluate technical trade-offs and translate complex technical concepts into clear product requirements.
• Identify opportunities to improve product scalability, reliability, and customer experience.

Market & Industry Awareness
• Stay informed about industry trends, customer expectations, emerging technologies, and competitive developments.
• Monitor competitor offerings and identify opportunities to strengthen product capabilities.
• Develop a strong understanding of relevant industry and enterprise workflows.

Qualifications

Education
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field.
• MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification is a plus.
• Strong academic background from a reputed institution is preferred.

Experience
• 1–3 years of experience in Product Management, APM, Product Ownership, Engineering, Consulting, Business Analytics, or related roles.
• B2B SaaS / B2B enterprise product experience is mandatory.
• Experience working with enterprise customers or enterprise-facing products.
• Demonstrated experience owning features or products through the product lifecycle.
• Experience working closely with engineering teams on technical products.
• Exposure to fintech, financial services, payments, identity, infrastructure, or other technology-driven industries is preferred.

Required Skills
• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
• Strong product thinking and ability to identify and structure ambiguous problems.
• Comfortable working with data, dashboards, product metrics, and analytics.
• Strong technical understanding and ability to collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to work effectively with cross-functional and external stakeholders.
• Strong ownership mindset and attention to detail.
• Ability to understand enterprise customer problems and translate them into product solutions.
• Curiosity to understand how complex technology products and systems work.

Preferred Skills
• Started your career as a Software Engineer/Developer and transitioned into Product Management.
• Experience building or launching a product/feature from 0→1.
• Experience working on technically deep products involving APIs, integrations, infrastructure, identity, security, AI/ML, or platform products.
• Experience working with enterprise B2B SaaS customers.
• Experience in fintech, banking, brokerage, payments, lending, or financial services.
• Familiarity with experimentation, funnel analysis, and conversion optimization.
• Experience working in fast-paced, high-growth environments.

Why Join HyperVerge?
• Work on products that impact millions of users across industries.
• Build and scale B2B enterprise products solving meaningful customer problems.
• Learn directly from experienced product leaders and work closely with engineering and cross-functional teams.
• Gain exposure to product strategy, analytics, technical product development, execution, and customer problem-solving.
• Own meaningful product outcomes from day one.
• Get the opportunity to work on 0→1 product initiatives and technically complex product problems.
• Be part of a fast-growing company solving critical problems through technology and innovation.
